content.text2: AI-powered lead response and qualification for real estate
content.text3: Listr is an AI-powered lead-response and qualification platform built specifically for the real estate industry. It intercepts inbound leads from sources such as Zillow, Realtor.com, Facebook Lead Ads, brokerage websites, and custom webhooks, then responds through SMS or web chat in under 60 seconds, 24/7. The AI agent continues the conversation, qualifies the lead based on factors such as budget, timeline, financing status, and area of interest, and hands the conversation to a human agent when the lead is warm enough to convert.

content.text2: Turning scattered inbound leads into a consistent response workflow
content.text3: Real estate brokerages receive leads from multiple platforms, each with different sources, workflows, and response expectations. Listr brings those leads into a unified multi-tenant workspace while maintaining consistent role-based access across leads, conversations, calendar, marketing, and settings. The core product challenge is combining fast AI responses, human handoffs, lead qualification, scheduling, and reporting into one coherent workflow.

content.text2: A complete system of record for every prospect
content.text3: The Leads module manages the complete lifecycle of every prospect entering a workspace. Leads move through defined statuses including New, Contacted, Replied, Qualified, Nurturing, Booked, Converted, Dormant, Needs Attention, Opted Out, and Lost. The module also supports source tracking, filterable tabs, CSV/XLSX bulk imports, CSV exports, bulk deletion, advanced filtering, manual lead creation, agent assignment, linked properties, internal notes, and automated alerts.

content.text2: A unified inbox for AI and human conversations
content.text3: The Conversations module provides a shared inbox built around the same underlying message data as the lead system. Each conversation includes its source, unread state, latest message preview, status, and AI response state. The detail view visually separates AI messages, human agent replies, and client messages, while role permissions ensure viewers remain in read-only mode. A persistent context sidebar keeps lead information, notes, and activity available without leaving the inbox.

content.text2: Configure an AI agent around the brokerage's actual workflow
content.text3: Listr's AI agent is configured through a five-step wizard covering identity, knowledge, behavior, lead qualification, and launch review. Teams can define the agent's role, languages, personality, business knowledge, response tone, working hours, training documents, communication channels, response behavior, quiet hours, restricted topics, escalation routes, qualification questions, scoring weights, and the threshold that automatically marks and routes qualified leads.

content.text2: Automatically identify leads that are ready for a human
content.text3: The qualification system uses configurable questions and scoring weights across dimensions such as budget range, purchase timeline, mortgage pre-approval, and area of interest. The weights total 100, and brokerages can define an auto-qualification threshold. Leads that cross that threshold are automatically marked as Qualified and assigned to a human agent without requiring manual review.

content.text2: Give every agent the right level of access
content.text3: The Human Agents section gives brokerages control over their teams, roles, assignments, routing participation, notifications, and working hours. Each agent has performance statistics and a dedicated detail view. Routing rules can handle scenarios such as sending high-value listings to senior agents, forcing a handoff after a fixed number of AI turns, or assigning weekend inquiries to an on-call agent.

content.text2: Turn qualified conversations into scheduled appointments
content.text3: Listr includes a week-view calendar with availability settings, Google Calendar connection status, buffer times, and slot duration. Appointment booking supports property tours, meetings, follow-up calls, and open houses, with lead, property, and agent selection. The system also handles notifications, reminders, conflict checking, appointment details, rescheduling, cancellation, and completion workflows.

content.text2: Keep listing data connected to the lead workflow
content.text3: The Properties module combines property management with external synchronization. Brokerages can push listings to connected platforms or pull property data in, configure field mappings and sync frequencies, automatically import new leads and properties, choose lead-assignment strategies, and skip duplicates. Manual property creation supports detailed real-estate fields including address, property type, pricing, beds, baths, square footage, amenities, images, MLS information, and listing-agent details.

content.text2: Connect the platforms where real estate leads already live
content.text3: Listr integrates with major lead and business platforms including Zillow, Realtor.com, Facebook Lead Ads, Follow Up Boss, Twilio, Google Ads, TikTok, and custom webhooks. The integrations layer supports inbound lead capture, CRM synchronization, SMS communication, advertising connections, webhook testing, credential management, and source-level configuration.

content.text2: Connect campaign performance with lead generation
content.text3: The marketing dashboard brings together total spend, leads generated, cost per lead, and ROI alongside channel performance and active campaigns. Campaign creation covers platform selection, audience targeting, location reach, property type targeting, budgets, date ranges, and ad creative. Housing-ad compliance considerations are surfaced directly in the campaign workflow, while campaign controls allow teams to filter, pause, and resume campaigns based on their role.

content.text2: Measure response speed, conversion, and team performance
content.text3: Analytics provides a unified view across lead volume, average response time, reply rate, booked appointments, source performance, agent performance, conversion funnels, and response-time distribution. Reports extend this with exportable and schedulable reports covering agent performance, channel performance, and lead analytics, including AI-versus-human comparisons, ROI information, funnel performance, source mix, and property-level conversion data.

content.text2: From a new workspace to a live lead-response system
content.text3: New workspaces follow an eleven-step guided setup that covers workspace configuration, Twilio number connection, email setup, lead-source integration, AI voice and tone, messaging templates, real SMS testing, team invitations, billing-plan selection, and the final go-live summary. The flow gives users a clear checklist and estimated setup time before moving them into the live dashboard.

content.text2: Speed and consistency without losing the human handoff
content.text3: Listr is designed as a speed-and-consistency layer on top of an existing real-estate lead flow rather than as a generic chatbot. Its value comes from connecting rapid AI responses with qualification, routing, scheduling, integrations, analytics, and human intervention so brokerages can respond consistently while keeping people involved when a lead is ready for the next step.
